Medical Test Sites - Applications and Forms

The Washington Medical Test Site (MTS) licensure program is exempt from the Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments of 1988 (CLIA). You don't need to apply to Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) for a CLIA number. Your MTS license will contain both your MTS license number and your CLIA number.
Select the appropriate form to make updates to your existing license.

Update address, facility name, or personnel: Credential status change form (PDF) To update the laboratory director, submit supporting documentation with the request, such as diplomas or board certifications. If laboratory training or experience is required, examples of acceptable documentation may include, but are not limited to, letters from training programs or employers; training or workshop certificates; and attestation statements regarding an individual’s training and experience. Documentation supporting an individual’s education, training, and experience must be generated by someone other than the person attempting to meet the personnel qualification requirements.
Add or remove additional test sites: Multiple Test Sites and Temporary Test Sites Request Form (PDF)
Ownership change: Complete a new MTS application.
Add or delete tests for your license or update volumes: Test menu change form (PDF)
Close a Medical Test Site: Closure Request Form (PDF)
Waived and PPMP Tests (Fillable PDF) . This form isn't fillable in Microsoft Edge. We recommend using Chrome or Firefox.
Non-Waived and Non-PPMP Tests (Fillable PDF)
Personnel Qualification Requirements (PDF)
When applying for MTS licensure, the type of tests you will perform determine the type of license required to conduct testing. Review the four types of MTS licenses available below.
Contact the MTS Program if you need help determining your classification of testing or licensure.
Complete the Medical Test Site Application Packet (PDF) .
Waived Medical Test Site License
Choose this option if you will perform tests classified as waived by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) .
Provider Performed Microscopic Procedures (PPMP) Medical Test Site License
Choose this option if a licensed physician, dentist, advanced registered nurse practitioner, or physician assistant will perform any of the nine approved microscopic procedures (PDF) .
Anyone within your facility may perform tests classified as waived by the FDA under this license type.
Categorized Medical Test Site License
Choose this option if you will perform tests classified as moderate or high complexity by the FDA. You may also perform waived tests.
Specific personnel requirements apply based upon the type of testing performed.
Inspections will be performed by Department of Health Medical Test Sites (MTS) surveyors.
Accredited Medical Test Site License
Inspections will be performed by accreditation organization surveyors. You must separately apply to one of the approved accreditation organizations to monitor and inspect your facility:
ACHC (Accreditation Commission for Health Care)
A2LA (American Association for Laboratory Accreditation)
AABB (Association for the Advancement of Blood & Biotherapies)
ASHI (American Society of Histocompatibility and Immunogenetics)
CAP (College of American Pathologists)
COLA (Commission on Laboratory Accreditation)
The medical test site current fees can be found at WAC 246-338-990 .
